messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?

I can only discuss your own orders, so I can’t tell you whether your neighbour bought or returned one. Your order records show that your garden hose reel was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). Would you like me to check whether it can be refunded?
